title: Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Seatpost collar quick-release binder bolt. This rationale is driven by seatpost collar quick-release binder bolt and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for seat hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with Class 6g gauge
Go/No-Go ring gauging with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for seatpost collar quickrelease application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for seatpost collar quickrelease performance

faq.q: How much weight savings does Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt offer versus steel or aluminum?
faq.a: Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides a 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130 chromoly steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at the same strength. Compared to 6061-T6 aluminum, titanium's 3× higher yield strength (830 vs 275 MPa) allows 50-60% thinner walls, resulting in a net weight comparable to aluminum with 4× better fatigue life — critical for seatpost collar quickrelease.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Seatpost Collar Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for seatpost collar quickrelease.
